title: HF416 (2025-2026 Regular): Age of eligibility established to apply for permit to carry pistol at 18 years old.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-11; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/416/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed, 2025-02-11). The bill strikes the age "21" in the permit-eligibility clause and puts in "18".

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): (b) Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception set forth in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a permit to an applicant if the person: (1) has training in the safe use of a pistol; (2) is at least 18 years old and a citizen or a permanent resident of the United States;
